variants.name: baseline
variants.note: The live configuration, as the control arm: opus-5 on Claude Code.

variants.name: gpt-5.6-sol
variants.note: GPT-5.6 Sol through Codex. Named as the Codex CLI names it, not as OpenRouter does — the arm reaches the model through the Codex login, so no compatible-endpoint transform is involved. xhigh rather than max because max has no Codex spelling.

variants.name: direct-research
variants.note: The same model and runtime as baseline, mounting the forty narrow tools rather than the sixteen condensed ones. Both arms hold their tools directly, so what varies is granularity: a wide tool asks sources the agent would not have thought to ask, where a narrow one is asked only deliberately. The forecaster's system prompt carries ~40 tool descriptions rather than ~16, so a loss here may be prompt bloat rather than granularity. Delegation is the other axis and this arm does not touch it.
